channel.title: The Drill Down: Kansas City Chiefs
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 11: Cardinals at Chiefs
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: KC -16.5 · O/U 41.5 | Model KC 84% vs. market 90% | The game likely turns on Arizona's red-zone offense, which converts just 54% of trips against a Kansas City defense allowing 48%, best in the league. Patrick Mahomes, a top-ten quarterback, faces a pass defense ranked 28th, and Travis Kelce, a top-ten separator, should find room behind it. Our model gives Kansas City 84% to win, more cautious than the market, with the passing matchup, worth 4.9 points, driving the number.

item.title: Week 10: Chiefs at Falcons
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: KC -3 · O/U 47.5 | Model ATL 35% vs. market 39% | The Chiefs must hunt explosives against an Atlanta defense that allows 9.5% of plays to go big, ranked 32nd, while their pass rush, generating 22% pressure, has to beat the league's best protection. Drake London absorbs 27% of Atlanta's targets against a Kansas City pass defense ranked 23rd, which gives Michael Penix Jr. a clear outlet on early downs. Our model agrees with the market that Kansas City wins, and our number sits higher, driven by the rushing matchup worth 3.1 points.
